description: Surveyed terrain drawn by the topographic view. Coordinates are display meters, [east, north], on the same plane as data/locations.geojson. The schema is documented in the README. Contours are not stored here; the page draws them as decoration. This file ships with one example polygon. It is hidden until Show examples is on, and it is not a surveyed place.

properties.name: EXAMPLE grass
properties.notes: EXAMPLE. Not a survey. A sample surface polygon so the topographic fill can be checked. Hidden until Show examples is on.
